semantics.runtime_ms: UNCHANGED - this profile never replaces or scales node.runtime_ms
semantics.decomposition: measured coefficients only; per-request prefill/decode/image durations are unavailable
semantics.counts: input_token_count, output_token_count, and image_count are unavailable
semantics.coverage: direct GPU nodes only; nested composite GPU work is unsupported
semantics.kv: corrected = raw kv_peak minus logits buffer (0.2898 MB/token)
semantics.vision_absent_for: Qwen3-4B is a text-only planner and consumes no frames
semantics.strict_scope: strict only enforces the models listed in covered_models; YOLO detector and CPU adapters are outside the HF generate() phase profile by design
